results.en: What am I supposed to say when he puts it so logically?
results.current: 既然他说得这么有逻辑，我还能说什么呢？

results.en: You are not supposed to smoke here.
results.current: 这儿不该抽烟。
results.triageIssue: 意思基本对，但“这儿不该抽烟”不如“这里不准/不能抽烟”自然准确。

results.en: ... Aaah, just how am I supposed to cope with this I wonder?
results.current: ……唉，我到底该拿这事儿怎么办才好啊？

results.en: You are supposed to take off your shoes when entering a house in Japan.
results.current: 在日本，进屋得脱鞋。

results.en: You're supposed to have this poem memorized before our next class.
results.current: 下节课之前你应该把这首诗背下来。

results.en: We are all supposed to know the traffic rules.
results.current: 我们大家都应该了解交通规则。

results.en: It wasn't supposed to happen.
results.current: 这本不该发生的。

results.en: He wrote to me to the effect that he would visit me.
results.current: 他给我写信说他会来看我。

results.en: They said something to the effect of ‘I’m going in the same direction so, I’ll call a taxi and then why don’t you ride with me?’
results.current: 他们大概是说：‘我刚好顺路，我叫辆出租车，你跟我一起坐吧？’

results.en: He wrote her to the effect that he loved her.
results.current: 他给她写了封信，大意是他爱她。

results.en: She received the letter to the effect that he would soon be back.
results.current: 她收到一封信，说是他很快就会回来。

results.en: The doctor spoke to the effect that my father would soon get better.
results.current: 医生的大意是我父亲很快就会好起来的。
results.triageIssue: “spoke to the effect that”译为“医生的大意是”略不自然，缺少“说/表示”，但意思清楚。

results.en: We have a saying to the effect that a good neighbor is better than a faraway relative.
results.current: 我们有句老话，叫“远亲不如近邻”。

results.en: I received a letter from him to the effect that he could not accept my offer.
results.current: 我收到他的一封信，大意是他不能接受我的提议。

results.en: The government made an announcement to the effect that taxes would be raised.
results.current: 政府发布公告说要加税。

results.en: I received a letter from her to the effect that she couldn't accept my marriage proposal.
results.current: 我收到她的信，大意是她不能接受我的求婚。

results.en: He sent me a letter to the effect that his poultry farm would go bankrupt sooner or later.
results.current: 他给我写了封信，大意是说他的养鸡场迟早要倒闭。

results.en: She takes after her mother.
results.current: 她长得挺像她妈的。

results.en: The baby really takes after its father.
results.current: 宝宝长得真像他爸。

results.en: Dick takes after his mother in appearance.
results.current: 迪克长得像他妈妈。

results.en: Most boys take after their fathers.
results.current: 大多数男孩长得都像他爸。
results.triageIssue: “their fathers”译成“他爸”单数口语化，泛指中略不一致；更自然为“自己的爸爸/父亲”。

results.en: He takes after his father.
results.current: 他长得挺像他爸的。

results.en: Mike takes after his father in everything.
results.current: 麦克各方面都很像他爸爸。

results.en: Which of your parents do you take after?
results.current: 你长得更像你爸还是你妈？

results.en: She takes after her mother.
results.current: 她长得挺像她妈的。

results.en: Peter's very tall. He takes after his father.
results.current: 彼得个子很高，随他爸。
results.triageIssue: “随他爸”自然但较口语，含义可为像父亲，结合身高语境可接受。

results.en: Which of your parents do you take after in character?
results.current: 你的性格更像你爸爸还是你妈妈？

results.en: Don't you think Jane takes after her father?
results.current: 你不觉得简长得像她爸爸吗？

results.en: The baby takes after its father.
results.current: 宝宝长得像他爸爸。

results.en: Workers put up with silly rules for a long time.
results.current: 工人们长期忍受着那些愚蠢的规矩。

results.en: I can't put up with the inconvenience of country life.
results.current: 我忍受不了乡下生活的不便。

results.en: I can't put up with this hot weather.
results.current: 这鬼天气我受不了。

results.en: I cannot put up with his idleness any longer.
results.current: 我再也受不了他这么无所事事了。

results.en: You must put up with your new post for the present.
results.current: 现在的岗位你就先凑合干着吧。

results.en: I cannot put up with the noise any longer.
results.current: 我再也受不了这噪音了。

results.en: I can't put up with his insults any longer.
results.current: 我再也受不了他的侮辱了。

results.en: I just couldn't put up with the man smelling of whisky sitting next to me.
results.current: 坐在我旁边那个男的一身威士忌味，我实在受不了。

results.en: I can't put up with his violence any longer.
results.current: 我再也受不了他的暴力了。

results.en: Such a state of things cannot be put up with.
results.current: 这种情况真让人没法忍受。

results.en: I cannot put up with his idleness any longer.
results.current: 我再也受不了他这么无所事事了。

results.en: I can't put up with him.
results.current: 我受不了他。

results.en: Please give me a ring this evening.
results.current: 今晚记得给我打个电话。
results.triageIssue: “记得”增加了提醒语气，原文为礼貌请求；仍自然可用。

results.en: Give me a ring if you find out anything.
results.current: 发现什么了给我打个电话。

results.en: Please give me a ring this evening.
results.current: 今晚记得给我打个电话。
results.triageIssue: “记得”增加了提醒语气，原文为礼貌请求；仍自然可用。

results.en: Her car broke down on the way.
results.current: 她的车在路上坏了。

results.en: If the car breaks down, we'll walk.

results.en: My car broke down on the way.

results.en: My car, which broke down yesterday, has not been repaired yet.
results.current: 我的车昨天坏了，还没修好呢。

results.en: As our taxi broke down on the way, we had to walk to the station.
results.current: 我们的出租车半路坏了，只好走路去车站。

results.en: The car broke down, so they had to walk.
results.current: 车坏了，所以他们只好走着去。
results.triageIssue: “walk”译为“走着去”缺少目的地，但根据原句也未明示，基本可接受。

results.en: My motorcycle broke down on the way.
results.current: 我的摩托车在半路坏了。

results.en: This car is going to break down.
results.current: 这车快要坏了。

results.en: She turned down his proposal.
results.current: 她推掉了他的求婚。

results.en: Would you please turn down the TV?

results.current: 你把那机会推了也太傻了。

results.en: Will you please turn down the radio?
results.current: 能把收音机音量调小点吗？

results.current: 恐怕你涨工资的要求又被拒绝了。

results.en: I told them again to turn down the radio.
results.current: 我又跟他们说了一次，让把收音机音量调小点。

results.en: He flatly turned down our request.
results.current: 他一口回绝了我们的请求。

results.en: No wonder they turned down her offer.
results.current: 难怪他们拒绝了她的提议。

results.en: Could you turn down the radio?
results.current: 能把收音机声关小点吗？

results.en: He came across her at the station.

results.en: She came across some old documents in the closet.
results.current: 她在衣柜里翻出了一些旧文件。

results.current: 他的解释没怎么说清楚。

results.en: Your meaning didn't come across clearly.

results.en: He was evidently surprised when he came across me.
results.current: 他在遇见我的时候，明显吃了一惊。

results.en: She came across the street.
results.current: 她从马路对面过来了。

results.en: I came across this book in a secondhand bookstore.
results.current: 我是在旧书店偶然看到这本书的。

results.en: As soon as I left home, I came across her in the street.
results.current: 我一出门就在街上碰到她了。

results.en: He came across the Atlantic in a small sailboat.
results.current: 他驾着一艘小帆船横渡了大西洋。

results.en: A good idea came across her mind at the last moment.
results.current: 最后一刻，她突然有了个好主意。

results.en: I ran out of the room without knowing what I was doing.
results.current: 我稀里糊涂地就跑出了房间。

results.en: We ran out of gas on the way to downtown Tokyo.
results.current: 我们在去东京市中心的路上没油了。

results.en: She ran out of paper.

results.en: I'm running out of ideas.

results.en: We've run out of tea.

results.en: Our car ran out of gas after ten minutes.

results.current: 我跑得气喘吁吁。

results.en: After slapping Tom, Mary ran out of the room.
results.current: 玛丽扇了汤姆一巴掌后，跑出了房间。

results.en: Let's find a gas station; we've run out of fuel.

results.en: She made up her mind to be a secretary.

results.en: Have you made up your mind to become a teacher?

results.en: She's made up her mind to quit the company.
results.current: 她已经决定辞职了。

results.en: I'm off cigarettes for good.

results.current: 她跟我彻底告别了。

results.en: Sleep and wait for good luck.

results.en: Where do you want to go for your summer vacations this year?
results.current: 你今年暑假想去哪儿玩？

results.en: I'll try again.

results.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.
results.current: 总统在电视上对全国发表了讲话。

results.current: 这个点儿街上竟然一个人都没有，真奇怪。

results.en: Japanese shogi corresponds to chess.
results.current: 日本将棋跟国际象棋差不多。

results.en: Can Tom really speak French?
results.current: 汤姆真的会说法语吗？

results.en: Yuriko is planning to move into the furniture business.

results.en: Why did you give him your shoes?
results.current: 你干嘛把鞋给他？

results.en: The drought damaged all the crops there.
results.current: 旱灾让那儿的庄稼全毁了。

results.en: Open your heart and tell me everything.

results.en: Tom is loyal to his wife.

results.current: 人们发起了一项基金，要为死者立个纪念碑。

results.current: 怀特被人向警察告发说他是间谍。

results.en: His plan seems very good from my point of view.

results.en: The prisoners were set free.
results.current: 那些俘虏被放了。

results.en: I will do my best to finish it.
results.current: 我会尽力把它做完。

results.en: You can't afford to neglect your health.
results.current: 你可不能忽视自己的健康。

results.en: Where are the toilets?

results.en: Work like a bee.

results.en: I hope that you will get well soon.
results.current: 希望你早日康复。

results.en: I'd like to join a night bus tour.
results.current: 我想参加夜间观光巴士游。

results.en: I owe it you that I am still alive.
results.current: 我能活下来全多亏了你。

results.en: He was in a hurry to see his mother.
results.current: 他急着去见他妈。

results.en: The shoes you are wearing look rather expensive.
results.current: 你穿的这双鞋看着挺贵的。

results.en: This is the key I have been looking for.

results.en: This report isn't to the point.

results.en: "Past tense" is used in connection with actions in the past.
results.current: “过去式”用于描述发生在过去的动作。

results.en: Because the surroundings were so dark, he could not see anything.

results.current: 迈克人挺好的，他免费帮我修了车。

results.en: Tom spoke French.
results.current: 汤姆讲了法语。

results.en: His father is an impostor.
results.current: 他父亲是个骗子。

results.current: 派对什么时候举行？

results.en: She acquainted her daughter with classical music.
results.current: 她让女儿接触了古典音乐。

results.en: You don't have to answer right away.
results.current: 你不用马上回答。

results.en: She had a reputation for being well informed about her subjects.
results.current: 大家都说她对自己研究的领域很在行。

results.current: 我想要你们这最便宜的房间，住四个晚上。

results.current: 比尔很擅长辩论。

results.en: When you look for an annual diary, what's the most important thing you look for?

results.current: 听到声音，他往窗外看了一眼。

results.en: Please leave me alone.
results.current: 让我一个人静静吧。

results.en: The invention of the transistor introduced a new era.
results.current: 晶体管的发明开启了一个新时代。

results.current: 吉姆在过马路之前左右看了看。

results.en: She is intent on mastering French.

results.en: Whenever I see her, I remember her mother.
results.current: 每次见到她，我都会想起她妈妈。

results.en: I enjoyed myself.
results.current: 我玩得很开心。

results.en: How much money do you want?
results.current: 你想要多少钱？

results.en: Disease is a threat to human beings.
results.current: 疾病威胁着人类的健康。
results.triageIssue: 原文是“对人类构成威胁”，译文加了“健康”，意思合理但有所限定。

results.en: Where can I check my baggage?
results.current: 我在哪儿可以托运行李？

results.en: The children were told to stay within reach of their mother's voice.
results.current: 大人们叮嘱孩子们要在妈妈能喊得到的地方玩。
results.triageIssue: 意思基本准确自然，但加了“玩”，且“their mother's voice”略被改写为“妈妈能喊得到”。

results.en: This boat goes through the jungle.
results.current: 这条船穿过丛林。
results.triageIssue: “goes through”可能指航行穿过，译文“船穿过丛林”稍生硬，缺少动态/路线感。

results.en: That child is a headache.
results.current: 那孩子真让人头疼。

results.en: I think I'm gonna shit myself.
results.current: 我觉得我要拉裤子了。

results.en: This is Tom speaking. I'd like to speak to Ann.
results.current: 我是汤姆，我想找一下安。

results.en: I sometimes meet him at the club.
results.current: 我有时会在俱乐部碰到他。

results.en: He took great pains in the negotiation.
results.current: 他在谈判中费了不少劲。

results.en: I'll make allowances for your lack of experience.
results.current: 我会考虑到你经验不足的。

results.en: I don't have any Canadian friends.
results.current: 我没有加拿大朋友。

results.en: Let's drop by his house.
results.current: 咱们顺道去他家坐坐吧。

results.en: Have a nice vacation.
results.current: 假期愉快。

results.en: Where did all that self-confidence come from?
results.current: 你哪儿来的那么多自信？

results.en: Ken plays soccer every day.
results.current: 健每天都踢足球。
results.triageIssue: 人名 Ken 译为“健”可接受但较少见，可能应为“肯”；其余准确。

results.en: How much is the express?
results.current: 快车票多少钱？
results.triageIssue: “express”可指快车/快递/特快服务，译为“快车票”需依赖语境，可能过度具体。

results.en: The examination was not difficult in the least.
results.current: 考试一点儿都不难。

results.en: He is my brother, not father.
results.current: 他是我哥，不是我爸。

results.en: I ask you a question.
results.current: 我问你个问题。

results.en: Our project didn't get off the ground until he joined the company.
results.current: 直到他进公司，咱们的项目才算真正开始运作。

results.en: He is washing his car.
results.current: 他在洗车呢。

results.en: A promise given under a threat is worthless.
results.current: 在威胁下许下的诺言一文不值。

results.en: Also, there is a greater risk of accidents.
results.current: 此外，发生事故的风险也更大了。

results.en: In the Diet, often a politician or two leave without permission when a question becomes too personal.
results.current: 在国会上，要是问题问得太针对个人，总会有一两个政客不打招呼就走人。
results.triageIssue: “Diet”准确应为日本国会，译作“国会”可接受；“often”译为“总会”略偏强。

results.en: The house stood on the hill.
results.current: 房子以前在山上。
results.triageIssue: “stood”表示坐落/矗立，译文“以前在山上”把过去存在感说得太强，少了“坐落/矗立”含义。

results.en: Many western customs have taken root in Japan.
results.current: 很多西方习俗已经在日本扎根了。

results.en: I like writing novels more than reading them.
results.current: 比起看小说，我更喜欢写小说。

results.en: It is a lot of fun to drive a car.
results.current: 开车挺有意思的。

results.en: I'll put some coffee on.
results.current: 我去煮点咖啡。

results.en: As far as knowing health's worth once you've lost it goes, that's the same thing with parents, water or air.
results.current: 身体垮了才知道健康的重要，这跟父母、水或者空气是一样的道理。
results.triageIssue: 整体意思通顺，但原句结构较笨拙地表达“失去后才知价值”，译文对“父母、水或空气”的类比自然化了，略有重组。

results.en: What he says is very important.
results.current: 他说的话很重要。

results.en: We have a lot of time.
results.current: 我们时间多的是。

results.en: Betty has a sweet voice.
results.current: 贝蒂的声音甜甜的。

results.en: Tom asked for directions.
results.current: 汤姆问了路。

results.en: I thought she was pretty.
results.current: 我觉得她长得挺漂亮的。

results.en: He is keen on science.
results.current: 他对科学非常着迷。

results.en: What would you like to drink?
results.current: 想喝点什么？

results.en: Tom will have breakfast early tomorrow.
results.current: 汤姆明天早饭吃得早。

results.en: You shouldn't make too much of the fact.
results.current: 你不该把这事儿看得太重。

results.en: Taiwanese food isn't as spicy as Indian food.
results.current: 台湾菜没有印度菜那么辣。

results.en: I am sorry for you.
results.current: 我真为你感到难过。

results.en: I am in financial difficulties.
results.current: 我经济上遇到了困难。

results.en: The magnetite is attracted to the earth's magnetic field.
results.current: 磁铁矿会被地球磁场吸引。

results.en: She found a job as a typist.
results.current: 她找了份打字员的工作。

results.en: He is very learned.
results.current: 他很有学问。

results.en: For some reason or other she shook her head.
results.current: 不知道为什么，她摇了摇头。

results.en: He thought it over, and decided not to go.
results.current: 他想了想，决定不去了。

results.en: I go to bed at eleven every night.
results.current: 我每天晚上十一点睡觉。

results.en: The ship vanished over the horizon.
results.current: 船在地平线上消失了。

results.en: What are you speaking now? Esperanto, Spanish or Italian?
results.current: 你现在说的是什么？世界语、西班牙语还是意大利语？

results.en: There is nothing for it but to do it this way.
results.current: 没办法，只能这么办了。

results.en: This area is extremely isolated.
results.current: 这地方特别偏僻。

results.en: We were seated at the supper table.
results.current: 我们坐在了餐桌旁。

results.en: Is Mr Schmidt at home now?
results.current: 施密特先生现在在家吗？

results.en: The victims of the hurricane have not tasted food for three days.
results.current: 飓风灾民已经三天没吃东西了。

results.en: This case has an affinity with that one.
results.current: 这个案子和那个案子挺像的。
results.triageIssue: “has an affinity with”可指相似/关联，译为“挺像”偏口语且可能弱化“关联性”。

results.en: You can watch television.
results.current: 你可以看电视。

results.en: There was no student in the playground.
results.current: 操场上一个学生也没有。

results.en: For that experiment they need a complete vacuum.
results.current: 那个实验需要完全真空的环境。

results.en: It smells good, doesn't it?
results.current: 闻着挺香的，是吧？

results.en: He was bidding for popular support.
results.current: 他在争取大众的支持。

results.en: I'm a boy.
results.current: 我是个男生。

results.en: You can come with me.
results.current: 你可以跟我一起来。

results.en: The mountain is easy of access.
results.current: 那座山挺容易上去的。

results.en: I looked back upon my happy school days.
results.current: 我回想起了快乐的学生时代。

results.en: Tom remained single all his life.
results.current: 汤姆这辈子一直都是单身。

results.en: Tom likes being alone.
results.current: 汤姆喜欢独处。

results.en: I missed the train by two minutes.
results.current: 我晚了两分钟，没赶上火车。

results.en: When I woke up in the morning, there was no one in the house. I was abandoned for the whole day.
results.current: 早上醒来的时候，家里一个人也没有。我被丢下了一整天。

results.en: How should I know where he is?
results.current: 我哪知道他在哪儿啊？

results.en: In a few days, the baby will be able to walk.
results.current: 再过几天，宝宝就会走路了。

results.current: 我把钱包落下了。

results.current: 我能在这儿存一瓶酒吗？

results.en: She is living abroad.
results.current: 她住在国外。

results.en: I will join it!
results.current: 我会参加的！

results.current: 隔热效果太好的缺点是，很快就会变得太热。

results.en: You smell like cigarette smoke.
results.current: 你身上有一股烟味。

results.current: 我喜欢凯文·纳什。

results.en: I have a friend to correspond with from time to time.
results.current: 我有个偶尔写信联系的朋友。

results.en: That picture doesn't seem ugly to me; on the contrary, I think it's rather beautiful.
results.current: 我倒不觉得那张画丑，相反，我觉得挺好看的。

results.current: 虽然布朗家有七个孩子，但日子似乎还过得去。

results.en: That is tofu.

results.en: The whale is not a fish but a mammal.
results.current: 鲸鱼不是鱼，而是哺乳动物。

results.en: How well she plays the piano!
results.current: 她钢琴弹得真好！

results.en: Where on earth did you get that hat?
results.current: 你到底是从哪儿弄到那顶帽子的？

results.en: Tom was wearing a polo shirt.
results.current: 汤姆穿着件POLO衫。

results.en: There are many more students in the classroom today than yesterday.
results.current: 今天教室里的学生比昨天多得多。

results.en: Our teacher sometimes speaks quickly.
results.current: 我们老师有时候说话很快。

results.en: God is in me or else is not at all.
results.current: 上帝就在我心中，否则他就根本不存在。

results.en: The war ushered in a period of shortages and deprivation.
results.current: 战争开启了一个物资匮乏、生活贫困的时期。

results.en: You should go to sleep because you have work tomorrow.
results.current: 你该睡觉了，明天还要上班呢。

results.en: This soda is less sweet than that.
results.current: 这个苏打水没那个甜。

results.current: 法律对这种罪行有明确的处罚规定。

results.current: 我女朋友错过了去世界尽头的末班车，这可真是个麻烦。

results.en: Please take a seat.
results.current: 请坐。

results.current: 约翰今天值班。

results.current: 谢谢你能考虑。

results.en: He got injured in the traffic accident.
results.current: 他在那场车祸里受伤了。

results.en: This flower makes the room!
results.current: 这朵花给房间增色不少！

results.en: That's fairly reasonable.
results.current: 那还挺合理的。

results.current: 日本艺术家利用留白制造出的那种对比效果真的很绝。
results.triageIssue: 英文是名词短语/不完整句，强调“such telling effects of contrast”；译文加入“真的很绝”，语气和结构不忠实，且“telling”应为“显著/有力”。

results.en: You should ask your father for his advice and follow it.
results.current: 你应该问问你爸的意见并照着做。

results.current: 我刚去过银行。

results.en: You may as well keep your promise.
results.current: 你最好还是守信用。

results.en: Happy New Year!
results.current: 新年快乐！

results.en: "Is his story true?" "I'm afraid not."
results.current: “他说的是真的吗？”“恐怕不是。”

results.en: He isn't a man to take a bribe.
results.current: 他不是那种会收受贿赂的人。

results.en: I stayed up late last night reading a novel.
results.current: 昨晚我熬夜看小说了。

results.en: I can no longer stand the cold.
results.current: 我再也受不了这冷天气了。

results.current: 请别让我分心。

results.en: How would you like your eggs?
results.current: 你的蛋想怎么吃？

results.en: When he was about to pass, the Sphinx jumped in front of him.
results.current: 就在他要过去的时候，斯芬克斯突然跳到了他面前。

results.en: The situation is extremely critical.
results.current: 情况非常危急。

results.en: He went blind in the accident.
results.current: 他在事故中失明了。

results.en: My wife burst into tears.
results.current: 我老婆突然大哭起来。

results.en: I forgot to turn off the gas!
results.current: 我忘了关煤气了！

results.current: 我受不了那种老好人。

results.en: He answered incorrectly.
results.current: 他答错了。

results.en: The relative pronoun 'that' has two states, a nominative case and objective case, but there is no possessive case.
results.current: 关系代词“that”有主格和宾格，但没有所有格。

results.en: He is equal to the task.
results.current: 他能胜任这项任务。

results.en: A man came in and sat on the stool next to her.
results.current: 一个男人走进来，坐在了她旁边的凳子上。

results.en: You never listen, no matter how many times I tell you.
results.current: 不管我说多少遍，你从来都不听。

results.en: I had a time playing tennis.
results.current: 我打网球打得挺开心的。

results.en: Waiting for Kate, I saw Bob and Mary.
results.current: 等凯特的时候，我看到了鲍勃和玛丽。

results.current: 称量糖的时候记得把它抹平。

results.en: It isn't snowing, is it?
results.current: 没下雪吧？

results.en: Have a cup of tea, won't you?
results.current: 喝杯茶吧？

results.current: 凯特迷死那个经常上电视的新歌手了。

results.en: A fly can walk on the ceiling.
results.current: 苍蝇能在天花板上爬。

results.en: He asked her to call him later.
results.current: 他让她晚点给他打电话。

results.en: Guess who I met today.
results.current: 猜猜我今天碰见谁了。

results.en: I would ask him if I were you.
results.current: 我要是你的话，我就会去问他。

results.en: He has something of the artist in him.
results.current: 他身上带点艺术家的气质。

results.current: 这个拿来送礼也挺合适的。

results.en: The bee flew out the window.
results.current: 蜜蜂从窗户飞了出去。

results.en: Many advantages accrue to society from the freedom of speech.
results.current: 言论自由给社会带来了很多好处。

results.en: I completed the whole high school curriculum.

results.current: 看一个人的朋友，就能看出他是个什么样的人。

results.current: 我哥加入了棒球俱乐部。

results.current: 汤姆敲了敲门。

results.current: 要是打仗了，我们该怎么办？

results.current: 汤姆靠在我身上。

results.current: 鲸鱼以小鱼为食。

results.en: We took it for granted that he would approve of the plan.
results.current: 我们想当然地认为他会赞成这个计划。

results.en: Grapes grow in bunches.
results.current: 葡萄是一串一串长的。

results.en: I always view this photo with disgust.
results.current: 我一看到这张照片就觉得恶心。

results.en: I saw the man jump.
results.current: 我看到那个人跳了下去。
results.triageIssue: “jump”未必是“跳下去”，可能只是跳了一下；译文加入方向/结果，意义可能偏。

results.en: What she wrote is true in a sense.
results.current: 她写的那些，从某种程度上说确实是真的。

results.en: She got to the hotel late at night.
results.current: 她半夜才到酒店。
results.triageIssue: “late at night”是深夜/夜里很晚，不一定“半夜”；略有时间偏差。

results.en: He will be writing a letter.
results.current: 他到时候会正在写信。
results.triageIssue: 准确体现将来进行时，但“到时候会正在写信”中文很别扭；应为“他那时会在写信”。

results.en: I found the work easy, since I had done that kind of work before.
results.current: 我觉得这活儿挺简单的，毕竟我以前做过这种。
results.triageIssue: “做过这种”后缺少“活/工作”，口语可懂但略不完整。

results.en: Let me know the result as soon as you can.
results.current: 有结果了尽快告诉我。

results.en: Put on me to the office.
results.current: 帮我接一下办公室。

results.en: That amount of food will last them for a week.
results.current: 那点食物够他们吃一个星期了。

results.en: Are the party preparations okay?
results.current: 聚会准备得怎么样了？

results.en: The news made him happy.
results.current: 这消息让他很高兴。

results.en: Almost everybody was invited.
results.current: 几乎所有人都被邀请了。

results.en: Tom is doing a crossword puzzle.
results.current: 汤姆在玩填字游戏。
results.triageIssue: “doing a crossword puzzle”更准确是“做填字游戏/填字谜”，“玩”稍口语但可接受。

results.en: He has transmitted all his knowledge to his son.
results.current: 他把所有的知识都教给了儿子。
results.triageIssue: “transmitted”译为“教给”自然，但略弱化“传授/传给”全部知识的意味。

results.en: Children catch colds easily.
results.current: 小孩特别容易感冒。

results.en: He made a careless mistake, as is often the case with him.
results.current: 他这人就这样，又犯了个粗心的错误。
results.triageIssue: 意思自然，但“as is often the case with him”译得较口语，略带评价色彩。

results.en: How did you solve the problem?
results.current: 你是怎么解决这个问题的？

results.en: Take your umbrella with you in case it rains.
results.current: 带把伞吧，万一下雨呢。

results.en: Will you please call me a taxi?
results.current: 麻烦帮我叫辆车好吗？
results.triageIssue: “taxi”译为“车”略泛化，通常应为“出租车”。

results.en: It is strange that he should have lost his way.
results.current: 真奇怪，他居然会迷路。

results.en: She knew the story already.
results.current: 她已经知道那个故事了。

results.en: You may come with us if you want to.
results.current: 想来的话可以跟我们一起。

results.en: Don't stick your hand out of the window.
results.current: 别把手伸出窗外。

results.en: Wisdom is a treasure for tens of generations.
results.current: 智慧是世世代代的财富。

results.en: Tears were dropping from her eyes.
results.current: 泪珠从她的眼里滴落。

results.en: He is a man who will do what he wants.
results.current: 他这人想干嘛就干嘛。

results.en: It is important that you attach your photo to the application form.
results.current: 记得在申请表上贴上你的照片。
results.triageIssue: “It is important”译成“记得”弱化了重要性，但实际指令清楚。

results.en: He is known to almost everybody throughout the world.
results.current: 差不多全世界的人都认识他。

results.en: I take it that you are fully acquainted with the facts.
results.current: 我想你应该对事实情况已经很了解了。
results.triageIssue: “I take it”译为“我想你应该”基本对，但“facts”译为“事实情况”略笼统。

results.en: He came back after two hours.
results.current: 他两个小时后回来了。

results.en: If he should be busy, help him.
results.current: 要是他正忙着，你就帮帮他。

results.en: The child was hiding in the box.
results.current: 孩子躲在箱子里。

results.en: Being an only child, he was the sole heir.
results.current: 他是独生子，所以他是唯一的继承人。

results.en: You didn't keep your word.
results.current: 你没守信用。

results.en: He has a notion that life is a voyage.
results.current: 他觉得人生就是一场航行。

results.en: They named their baby Jane.
results.current: 他们给宝宝起名叫简。

results.en: In getting her present job, she made capital of her father's connections.
results.current: 她能找到现在的工作，全靠她父亲的关系。
results.triageIssue: “made capital of”有“利用”关系之意，“全靠”略强化依赖程度，但总体准确自然。

results.en: It is a pity you cannot come.
results.current: 真可惜你来不了。

results.en: He got all the worse because he took the medicine.
results.current: 他吃了药反而病得更重了。

results.en: This church has stained glass windows.
results.current: 这座教堂有彩色玻璃窗。

results.en: Can I be excused?
results.current: 我可以先失陪一下吗？
results.triageIssue: 语境若为课堂/会议请求离开，“先失陪一下”较社交化；但大意可用。

results.en: The motorman slowed down the train.
results.current: 司机让火车减速了。
results.triageIssue: “motorman”可指电车/列车驾驶员，“司机”可以；整体自然。

results.en: Tom was happy to be home after being away for so long.
results.current: 离家这么久终于回来了，汤姆挺高兴的。

results.en: Yumi speaks very good English.
results.current: 由美的英语说得棒极了。
results.triageIssue: “very good English”译为“棒极了”略夸张口语，但可接受。

results.en: Politicians are good at raising money.
results.current: 政客们都很擅长筹款。

results.en: It's not worth much.
results.current: 这不值几个钱。

results.en: This fruit has an unpleasant smell.
results.current: 这水果的味道不太好闻。

results.en: Seeing these islands from the airplane, we thought that they were really beautiful.
results.current: 在飞机上看到这些岛屿时，我们觉得它们真的太美了。

results.en: We'll face that problem when we come to it.
results.current: 等遇到了那个问题再说吧。

results.en: Did you see him go out?
results.current: 你看见他出去了吗？

results.en: He is no better than a thief.
results.current: 他跟小偷没什么两样。

results.en: That island was governed by France at one time.
results.current: 那座岛曾经由法国统治。

results.en: The wicked man is scared of heights.
results.current: 那个坏蛋竟然恐高。
results.triageIssue: “wicked man”译为“坏蛋”较口语；“竟然”增加了原文没有的意外语气。

results.en: In about two weeks.
results.current: 大概两周以后。

results.en: I'm willing to take care of your children, if you want me to.
results.current: 你要是愿意，我可以帮你带孩子。
results.triageIssue: “if you want me to”是“如果你想让我照看”，译成“你要是愿意”改变了施事/意愿对象，容易误解。

results.en: Who wrote such an unrefined article?
results.current: 谁写的这么没水平的文章？
results.triageIssue: “unrefined”译为“没水平”较口语，含义接近但不够精确。

results.en: Deeds, not words.
results.current: 看行动，别光说。

results.en: Can you hold on a little longer?
results.current: 能再坚持一下吗？

results.en: I think it's dangerous to swim in that river.
results.current: 我觉得去那条河里游泳很危险。

results.en: Your pulse is normal.
results.current: 你的脉搏很正常。

results.en: "Is it a cupboard?" Replied Pip.
results.current: “那是碗橱吗？”皮普回答道。
results.triageIssue: 英文是“Pip replied”，应为“皮普回答说/答道”；当前让“那是碗橱吗？”成为皮普的回答，叙述关系可疑且不自然。

results.en: Small animals are very cute.
results.current: 小动物都挺可爱的。
results.triageIssue: “都”略泛化为所有小动物；原文是泛称，仍可接受。

results.en: Japanese differ from American in many respects.
results.current: 日本人在很多方面都和美国人不同。

results.en: He has a foreign car.
results.current: 他有一辆进口车。
results.triageIssue: “foreign car”可为外国车，“进口车”在中文语境常见但不一定完全等同。

results.en: I hope to see you soon.
results.current: 希望能快点见到你。

results.en: I remember seeing you somewhere.
results.current: 我记得在哪儿见过你。

results.en: I'll lend you this book.
results.current: 这本书我借给你。

results.en: He is a Japanese boy.
results.current: 他是个日本男孩。

results.en: I had a slight headache last night.
results.current: 昨晚我有点头疼。

results.en: Please don't mumble.
results.current: 说话别在那嘀嘀咕咕的。
results.triageIssue: 语气比原文更责备、更口语，但含义准确。

results.en: You should be ready for the worst.
results.current: 你得做好最坏的打算。

results.en: He is still fully active.
results.current: 他现在还活跃得很。

results.en: They congratulated him on his marriage.
results.current: 他们祝贺他新婚快乐。
results.triageIssue: “on his marriage”是祝贺他结婚；“新婚快乐”自然但偏祝福语。

results.en: It is hard to wake up without a strong cup of coffee.
results.current: 不喝杯浓咖啡，我真的醒不过来。

results.en: Come what may, I won't stop making music.
results.current: 不管发生什么，我都不会停止做音乐。

results.en: I recorded the conditions up until now!
results.current: 我把到目前为止的情况都录下来了！
results.triageIssue: “recorded”可能是记录而非录音/录像；“录下来了”偏向录制，语境不明时稍窄。

results.en: Love alone isn't enough for a successful international marriage.
results.current: 跨国婚姻，光有爱可是不够的。

results.en: Let's get together here once a week.
results.current: 咱们一个星期在这儿聚一次吧。

results.en: I can not do without this dictionary even for a single day.
results.current: 我一天也离不开这本字典。

results.en: He may have missed the train.
results.current: 他可能没赶上火车。

results.en: She just can't have the nerve to lift it up now!
results.current: 她现在肯定没胆量把它拎起来！
results.triageIssue: “can't have the nerve”译为“肯定没胆量”基本对，但“just”语气和“now”略生硬。

results.en: She accepted our invitation.
results.current: 她接受了我们的邀请。

results.en: Of the three candidates, I think Mr. Smith is the best.
results.current: 这三个候选人中，我认为史密斯先生是最出色的。

results.en: I made a new friend today.
results.current: 我今天交了个新朋友。

results.en: Take a map with you in case you get lost.
results.current: 带上地图，省得迷路。

results.en: The root of a flower is as weak as a baby's finger.
results.current: 花根就像婴儿的手指一样细弱。
results.triageIssue: “weak”译为“细弱”自然，但可能漏掉“脆弱”意味。

results.en: If I were you, I wouldn't do it.
results.current: 我要是你，我就不去做那件事。

results.en: Can't you stay a little longer?
results.current: 你就不能再多待会儿吗？

results.en: I love French culture.
results.current: 我喜欢法国文化。

results.en: I was almost hit by a car.
results.current: 我刚才差点被车撞到。

results.en: I study French every day.
results.current: 我每天都学法语。

results.en: Is it possible that you're wrong?
results.current: 有没有可能你搞错了？

results.en: He's a volleyball player.
results.current: 他是排球运动员。

results.en: We stayed at my aunt's during the vacation.
results.current: 假期里我们住在姨妈家。

results.en: He was kind enough to show me the way.
results.current: 他人真好，给我指了路。

results.en: She lives quite close by.
results.current: 她就住在附近。

results.en: As a matter of fact, he doesn't agree with me.
results.current: 事实上他并不赞同我。

results.en: To the best of my knowledge, he is innocent.
results.current: 据我所知，他是无辜的。

results.en: He's not doing a very good job. All the same, you've got to admit that he's doing his best.
results.current: 他干得不怎么样。但即便如此，你还是得承认他已经尽力了。

results.en: That question still sticks me.
results.current: 那个问题还是把我给难住了。

results.en: I can't take any more.
results.current: 我再也受不了了。

results.en: I can see the tiniest spot.
results.current: 再小的污点我也能看见。

results.en: I am near-sighted, so I cannot make out what is written on that signboard.
results.current: 我有点近视，看不清那块招牌上写的什么。

results.en: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
results.current: 这个故事听起来可能有点奇怪，但绝对是真的。

results.en: The chocolate that Tom is eating was given to him by his girlfriend.
results.current: 汤姆正在吃的巧克力是他女朋友送的。

results.en: Sulfur is used to make matches.
results.current: 硫磺是用来做火柴的。

results.en: I bought it on credit.
results.current: 我是赊账买的。

results.en: I'm happy to be with you.
results.current: 能和你在一起我很高兴。

results.en: Tom closed the door quietly and tiptoed into the room.
results.current: 汤姆悄悄关上门，踮着脚尖进了房间。

results.en: I quarrelled with my older brother yesterday.
results.current: 我昨天跟我哥吵了一架。

results.en: All the skill of the sailors gave way to the violence of the storm.
results.current: 尽管水手技术很好，但还是没能扛住那场大风暴。
results.triageIssue: 表达了风暴压倒水手技能的意思，但“All the skill...gave way”译为“尽管技术很好”略概括，且“violence”不只是“大”。

results.en: Exhausted from a day's work, he went to bed much earlier than usual.
results.current: 干了一天活累坏了，他比平时早得多就睡了。

results.en: I must have a haircut at the barber's today.
results.current: 我今天得去理个发。

results.en: Anything new today?
results.current: 今天有什么新鲜事吗？

results.en: The swimming pool is open to the public.
results.current: 游泳池对公众开放。

results.en: The man is wearing a pair of glasses.
results.current: 那个男人戴着一副眼镜。

results.en: I need his help.
results.current: 我需要他的帮助。

results.en: I have an allergy to pollen.
results.current: 我花粉过敏。

results.en: When I hear this song, I associate it with his name.
results.current: 听到这首歌，我就会想到他的名字。

results.en: Mary's dad is rich.
results.current: 玛丽的老爸很有钱。

results.en: I would like to leave work early today if possible.
results.current: 如果方便的话，我今天想早点下班。
results.triageIssue: “如果方便的话”略偏向对方是否方便，但整体自然准确。

results.en: It's not worthwhile going there.
results.current: 去那儿不值得。

results.en: As was mentioned before, this is my basic idea.
results.current: 就像之前提到的，这就是我的基本想法。

results.en: Passport, please.
results.current: 请出示护照。

results.en: There was a phone call from a girl.
results.current: 有个女孩打来过电话。

results.en: It will not be long before business returns to normal.
results.current: 生意很快就会恢复正常的。

results.en: She suggested that we go shopping to Motomachi next Sunday.
results.current: 她建议我们下个周日去元町逛街。

results.en: He went round the corner at top speed.
results.current: 他飞快地绕过了那个弯。

results.en: He revealed the secret to her.
results.current: 他把秘密告诉了她。

results.en: He has more sense than to say such a foolish thing.
results.current: 他才没那么傻，会说出这种话。
results.triageIssue: 意思基本到位，但中文逗号后接“会说出”略不自然，可作“才不会傻到说出”。

results.en: Sales are down now.
results.current: 现在的销售额下降了。

results.en: He values honor above anything else.
results.current: 他把名誉看得比什么都重。

results.en: I found the picture Tom was looking for.
results.current: 我找到了汤姆在找的那张照片。

results.en: I was flat on my back for a week with a terrible cold.
results.current: 我因为感冒重得在床上躺了一个星期。
results.triageIssue: “感冒重得”不太自然，应为“重感冒/感冒很重”。

results.en: Will you look after my children for me?
results.current: 你能帮我照看下孩子吗？

results.en: I felt the brush of her hand against me.
results.current: 我感觉到她的手轻轻碰了我一下。

results.en: The train was so crowded that I had to keep standing all the way.
results.current: 火车上人多得我只好一路站着。

results.en: His car is a new model.
results.current: 他的车是新款。

results.en: Don't be ashamed of yourself.
results.current: 别觉得不好意思。
results.triageIssue: “ashamed of yourself”更偏“别为自己感到羞愧/惭愧”，译成“不好意思”语气偏轻。

results.en: Do you mind if I ask you a question?
results.current: 你介意我问个问题吗？

results.en: It is easy for us to agree with his opinion.
results.current: 我们很容易就能赞成他的观点。
results.triageIssue: 语义可理解，但“easy for us to agree”译作“很容易就能赞成”稍生硬。

results.en: They must love you.
results.current: 他们一定很爱你。

results.en: I live near the train station.
results.current: 我住在火车站附近。

results.en: There is more water than is needed.
results.current: 水比需要的多。

results.en: The police are after me.
results.current: 警察在追我。

results.en: They communicate with each other by mail.
results.current: 他们靠写信联系。
results.triageIssue: mail 可指邮件/邮寄；“写信”偏传统信件，但通常可接受。

results.en: I am very fond of travelling by train.
results.current: 我特别喜欢坐火车旅行。

results.en: You are good at speaking English, aren't you?
results.current: 你英语说得很好，不是吗？

results.en: You are idle to the bone.
results.current: 你简直懒到骨子里了。

results.en: I had barely got aboard when the train began to move.
results.current: 我刚跨上车，火车就开始动了。

results.en: He is thinking of going to sea.
results.current: 他在考虑去当海员。

results.en: I thought Tom would want butter on his toast.
results.current: 我以为汤姆想在吐司上抹黄油。

results.en: I am very interested in these stories.
results.current: 我对这些故事特别感兴趣。

results.en: Do you have an age by which you want to get married?
results.current: 你有想过要在几岁前结婚吗？

results.en: I'm not sure how to pronounce the word.
results.current: 我拿不准这个词该怎么读。

results.en: I could not help feeling sorry for him.
results.current: 我忍不住觉得他挺可怜的。

results.en: She regarded me suspiciously.
results.current: 她一脸怀疑地看着我。

results.en: He's always on the go, from morning to night.
results.current: 他从早忙到晚，一刻也不停。

results.en: I like a dog better than a cat, for the former is more faithful than the latter.
results.current: 比起猫我更喜欢狗，因为狗比猫更忠心。

results.en: He exclaimed, "What a dirty face you have!"
results.current: 他叫道：“你的脸怎么这么脏啊！”

results.en: Miss Smith is liked by all students.
results.current: 史密斯小姐深受所有学生的喜爱。

results.en: My watch is broken, so I want a new one.
results.current: 我的表坏了，我想买个新的。

results.en: I'll let you know all about it later on.
results.current: 回头我会把所有细节都告诉你的。
results.triageIssue: “all about it”不一定是“所有细节”，略有增译但自然。

results.en: Cholera is uncommon in Japan.
results.current: 霍乱在日本很少见。

results.en: We thought it wrong to leave her alone.
results.current: 我们觉得把她一个人丢在那儿不太好。
results.triageIssue: “leave her alone”译为“丢在那儿”稍口语且可能暗示地点，但意思基本对。

results.en: I'm a stranger here myself. I'm afraid that I can't help you.
results.current: 我也是外地人，恐怕帮不了你。

results.en: The baby cried all night.
results.current: 宝宝哭了一整夜。

results.en: I'm sorry if I hurt you.

ja.en: We left by train.
ja.current: 電車で出発しましました。
ja.triageIssue: Typo/malformed: 出発しましました should be 出発しました.

ja.en: You should carry out his offer.
ja.current: 君は最初の計画を実行すべきだ。
ja.triageIssue: offer を『最初の計画』と誤訳しており、別文の混入のようで意味が違う。

ja.en: Regardless of how much he drank, he seems as sober as ever.
ja.current: 彼はどんなに、飲んでも全くくらしふうにみえる。
ja.triageIssue: 「全くくらしふうにみえる」が破綻しており、sober as everの意味になっていない。

ja.en: No attention was paid to his warning.
ja.current: 彼の不注意さは不用意だった。
ja.triageIssue: 原文と無関係で意味が完全に誤り。

ja.en: I cannot put up with his idleness any longer.
ja.current: 彼の怠惰なはもはや我慢できない。
ja.triageIssue: 「彼の怠惰なは」は文法的に壊れている。

ja.en: The long discussion came to an end at last.
ja.current: 長い講義がやっと終わった。
ja.triageIssue: Mistranslates discussion as lecture (講義); meaning is wrong.

ja.en: I failed to come on account of a heavy snowfall.
ja.current: 大雪のために列車は遅れた。
ja.triageIssue: 原文は「大雪のため私は来られなかった」だが、訳は列車が遅れたとなっており別内容。

ja.en: It was raining and the game was called off.
ja.current: 雨が降って試合はコールドゲームになった。
ja.triageIssue: Called off mistranslated as called game/コールドゲーム, not cancelled.

ja.en: The game was called off because it rained.
ja.current: 雨が降ったので試合はコールドゲームになった。
ja.triageIssue: Called off means canceled; コールドゲーム is a called/ended game, not necessarily canceled.

ja.en: You have to make do with what you've got.
ja.current: 自分で引き受けたことは自分で処理しなければならない。
ja.triageIssue: 『make do with what you've got』は『手元にあるもので何とかやりくりする』の意味。訳は『引き受けたことを処理する』で誤訳。

ja.en: It is good to keep studying all your life.
ja.current: 一生懸命し続けることはいいことだ。
ja.triageIssue: studyingが訳されず、「一生懸命し続ける」は文法的にも不自然で意味が違う。

ja.en: I'm fed up with English.
ja.current: 私は英語名はうんざりだ。
ja.triageIssue: Malformed: 英語名は; wrong grammar.

ja.en: We were given the privilege to use the liberty.
ja.current: 私たちは図書館利用の特権を与えられた。
ja.triageIssue: English says “liberty” but Japanese translates it as “library” (図書館), changing the meaning.

ja.en: Your gift was like discovery of an oasis in the midst of a desert.
ja.current: 死中に活を求める。
ja.triageIssue: Unrelated idiom; does not translate the oasis-in-desert metaphor/gift meaning.

ja.en: Has Lucy already called?
ja.current: ルーシーはもう呼んだのか?
ja.triageIssue: called を「電話した」ではなく「呼んだ」と誤訳している。

ja.en: Whatever doesn't kill us only makes us stronger.
ja.current: 継続は力なり。
ja.triageIssue: 継続は力なり means persistence is power; unrelated to adversity making us stronger.

ja.en: Tom finally made up his mind to ask Mary out.
ja.current: メアリさんはついにトムさんにデートに誘われました。
ja.triageIssue: 主語と行為が逆で、TomがMaryを誘う意味がMaryが誘われた受動になっている。

ja.en: I'm better.
ja.current: 僕のほうがいいです。
ja.triageIssue: I'm better は通常「具合がよくなった」等だが、「僕のほうがいい」は比較の別意味。

ja.en: Tom is universally acknowledged (including by himself) as a man who makes things happen [a playmaker/rainmaker].
ja.current: トムは自他ともに認める雨男だ。
ja.triageIssue: 雨男 means a man who brings rain/weather bad luck, not a playmaker/rainmaker who makes things happen.

ja.en: According to the internet, extraordinary things are thought to be interesting.
ja.current: インターネットによると、非常に興味深いと思います。
ja.triageIssue: Omits “extraordinary things” and mistranslates as “very interesting”; sentence meaning is wrong.

ja.en: In an emergency you can fall back on your savings.
ja.current: まさかのときには貯蓄すればいい。
ja.triageIssue: fall back on your savings は「貯金を頼りにできる」だが、「貯蓄すればいい」は意味が誤り。

ja.en: Do you fail a test you are capable of doing?
ja.current: あなたも能力試験に失敗しますか。
ja.triageIssue: Mistranslates 'a test you are capable of doing' as ability test; meaning is not conveyed.

ja.en: Peter takes after his mother more than his father.
ja.current: ピーターは父より母にである。
ja.triageIssue: Malformed and incomplete; should say he resembles/takes after his mother more.

ja.en: The game was called off because of the rain.
ja.current: 試合は雨の為にコールドゲームになった。
ja.triageIssue: Called off means canceled, but コールドゲーム is a called game/mercy or weather-shortened game, not cancellation.

ja.en: Would you take part in the project?
ja.current: その計画に参加させてもらえませんか。
ja.triageIssue: Reverses the subject/intent: Japanese means “Could I be allowed to participate?” not “Would you take part?”

ja.en: What are you eyeing?
ja.current: おまえの目は節穴か？
ja.triageIssue: Completely wrong idiom; means 'Are you blind?/Are your eyes useless?' not 'What are you looking at/eyeing?'.

ja.en: That girl is a true blue country singer.
ja.current: あの女の子は信頼できるカントリーシンガーだ。
ja.triageIssue: Misreads idiom 'true blue' here as trustworthy; intended likely genuine/authentic country singer.

ja.en: In spite of the fact that he was tired, he continued working.
ja.current: 疲れているいないにかかわらず、彼は作業を続けた。
ja.triageIssue: Reverses/changes meaning to “regardless of whether he was tired or not” instead of “although he was tired.”

ja.en: She considered him to be a blessing.
ja.current: 彼女は彼を幸せにしました。
ja.triageIssue: 「彼を恵み・ありがたい存在だと考えた」の意味だが、「彼を幸せにしました」は誤訳。

ja.en: She takes every circumstance into account.
ja.current: 彼女はすべての事情を利用する。
ja.triageIssue: Mistranslates “take into account” as “make use of”; meaning is wrong.

ja.en: It would be something I'd have to program.
ja.current: それは私が調整しなければいけなかった何かだったんだろう。
ja.triageIssue: Wrong tense/modality and verb: 'would have to program' becomes 'had to adjust something'; meaning significantly distorted.

ja.en: Do you think he made that mistake on purpose?
ja.current: 君が彼がその間違いをわざとしたと思うかい。
ja.triageIssue: 「君が彼が」が文法的に不自然で、質問文として破綻気味。

ja.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
ja.current: 家はかなりにみえたし、しかも値段が手頃だった。
ja.triageIssue: 家はかなりにみえた is ungrammatical and omits 'good' meaning.

ja.en: He was accused of theft.
ja.current: 彼はぬすみでうったえられた。
ja.triageIssue: うったえられた usually means sued/complained against; for accused of theft should be 窃盗の罪で告発/起訴された. Hiragana also unnatural.

ja.en: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
ja.current: 長い結論のすえ彼らは１つの計画を出した。
ja.triageIssue: 長い結論のすえ is malformed/wrong; should be 長い議論の末. Translation is awkward and partially mistranslates “discussion.”

ja.en: Early to bed and early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
ja.current: 朝起きは三文の徳。
ja.triageIssue: 朝起き is not the standard proverb; should be 早起きは三文の徳. Also omits early-to-bed aspect as expected for the proverb equivalent.

ja.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
ja.current: 朝起きは三文の徳。
ja.triageIssue: 朝起きは三文の徳 is nonstandard/awkward; should be 早起きは三文の徳.

ja.en: In early times, inventions were often stumbled upon by accident.
ja.current: 昔は偶然ぶつかったことが発明となった例が多い。
ja.triageIssue: 偶然ぶつかったこと is a literal/misleading rendering of “stumbled upon”; the sentence is unnatural and semantically off.

ja.en: Who loves not women, wine and song remains a fool his whole life long.
ja.current: 英雄色を好む。
ja.triageIssue: Japanese proverb means great men like women/romance; it omits wine/song and the 'fool his whole life' meaning.

ja.en: Sometimes I will be weak.
ja.current: 時には弱音を吐くけど。
ja.triageIssue: 「弱いこともある」という意味を「弱音を吐く」と訳しており意味が変わっている。文も断片的。

ja.en: I failed to get the position I wanted.
ja.current: 私望んでいた地位を手に入れることができなかった。
ja.triageIssue: 「私望んでいた」と助詞抜けで文法が壊れている。意味は推測できるが品質に問題。

ja.en: I ran out of breath.
ja.current: 私は息を切らせて走った。
ja.triageIssue: ran out of breathは息が切れた意味で、翻訳は「走った」を追加して誤解を生む。

ja.en: I bent over to pick up the pen.
ja.current: 私はペンを拾うと身をかがめた。
ja.triageIssue: 「ペンを拾うと身をかがめた」は順序・因果が逆に読める。英語は拾うために身をかがめた。

ja.en: In my opinion, we need to diversify our assets.
ja.current: 私の考えでは、資産の多角的に投資する必要がある。
ja.triageIssue: 文法が壊れている。「資産を多角的に投資する」は不自然で、diversify assets の訳として不適切。

ja.en: We went for a scenic drive as far as Lake Superior.
ja.current: 私たちはスペリオル湖まで景色のよい自動車動をドライブした。
ja.triageIssue: 「自動車動をドライブした」が誤字/破綻しており不自然。意味は一部取れるが品質が低い。

ja.en: People I admire most are those who do not see life in terms of power.
ja.current: 私が最も敬服する人は、人生の権力の見地から見ない人である。
ja.triageIssue: 「人生の権力の見地から見ない」が文法的に不自然で意味が取りにくい。

ja.en: There's a little black spot on the sun today.
ja.current: 今日の太陽に浮かんだ小さな黒点。
ja.triageIssue: 文として未完成で、「today」の意味も弱い。歌詞的断片なら可だが通常文としては不十分。

ja.en: Hiroki was at a loss what to do.
ja.current: 浩材はどうしてよいか途方にくれていた。
ja.triageIssue: The name Hiroki is mistranscribed as 浩材, likely a wrong/malformed proper name, though the rest is understandable.

ja.en: Both Ken's mother and her friend will arrive at the airport soon.
ja.current: 健のお母さんと友人の両方ともまもなく空港に着くでしょう。
ja.triageIssue: Ambiguous/wrong possessive: English means Ken's mother and Ken's mother's friend, but Japanese can read as Ken's mother and Ken's friend; 両方とも is also unnatural.

ja.en: The throng protested against abortion.
ja.current: 群衆は妊娠中絶に抗議した。
ja.triageIssue: 抗議した alone suggests protested to abortion rather than protested against/opposed abortion; should be 妊娠中絶に反対して抗議した.

ja.en: You acted after your nature. Think of all the trouble you would give him.
ja.current: 君らしいやり方をした。
ja.triageIssue: Only translates first clause; omits 'Think of all the trouble you would give him.'

ja.en: Let's go to a movie.
ja.current: 映画に行ったらどうですか。
ja.triageIssue: 英語は「映画に行こう」と一緒に行く提案だが、訳は「あなたが行ったらどうですか」という勧めに近い。

ja.en: Do you have change for a dollar?
ja.current: １ドルでおつりがありますか。
ja.triageIssue: 「1ドルを両替できますか」の意味だが、「1ドルでおつりがありますか」は不自然で誤解を招く。

ja.en: The other day I attended a class reunion of my elementary school.
ja.current: こないだクラス会に参加してきた。
ja.triageIssue: Omits elementary school and 'the other day' is only colloquially present as こないだ; クラス会 could be any class reunion.

ja.en: At last, James Bond made it as an actor.
ja.current: やっとジェームス・ボンドは俳優として成功した。
ja.triageIssue: Treats James Bond as a person becoming an actor; likely should be the actor who played James Bond, so misleading.

ja.en: He knows everything that there is to know about jazz.
ja.current: 彼はジャズについて知らなけばならないことは全部知っている。
ja.triageIssue: Typo/grammar error 知らなけば and mistranslates 'everything there is to know' as 'everything one must know'.

ja.en: That computer class was a waste of time.
ja.current: このコンピューターコースをやった（に通った）のは時間の無駄だった。
ja.triageIssue: 「この」になっており that とずれる。括弧入りで翻訳文として不自然・未処理。

ja.en: When is my next appointment?
ja.current: 私の次の申し合わせはいつですか。
ja.triageIssue: '申し合わせ' means arrangement/agreement, not appointment; unnatural and potentially misleading.

ja.en: According to her, he is a coward.
ja.current: 彼女に言わせれば、あいつは意気地なんだと。
ja.triageIssue: Missing noun ending: should be “意気地なし”; current Japanese is malformed.

ja.en: I'm used to staying awake late into the night.
ja.current: 私は宵っ張りするのは慣れています。
ja.triageIssue: Broken/unnatural grammar: 宵っ張りするのは慣れています; should be 夜更かしに慣れている.

ja.en: I think that everyone should study a foreign language.
ja.current: 誰にも外国語を習うべきだと思います。
ja.triageIssue: 「誰にも」は不自然で誤り。『誰もが/みんなが外国語を学ぶべきだ』が適切。

ja.en: It isn't just a human face.
ja.current: 人間顔だけじゃないよ。
ja.triageIssue: 「human face」を「人間顔」としており不自然で意味不明に近い。

ja.en: I hope you can come up with a better plan than this.
ja.current: 君はこれより良い計画を考え出すことができると思います。
ja.triageIssue: Misreads “I hope you can” as “I think you can,” changing modality and nuance.

ja.en: Originally the meeting was planned for next Saturday.
ja.current: まず第一に、会は次の土曜日に開くことに取り決められた。
ja.triageIssue: Originally mistranslated as まず第一に; planned/meeting phrasing is unnatural.

ja.en: It was nearly noon.
ja.current: ほとんど正午近かった。
ja.triageIssue: ほとんど正午近かった is unnatural/redundant; should be 正午近くだった/もうすぐ正午だった.

ja.en: The boy likes to walk to town.
ja.current: 男の子は町に歩くのが好きです。
ja.triageIssue: 「町に歩く」は不自然で誤りに近い。「町まで歩く／歩いて町へ行く」が必要。

ja.en: Staff members only.
ja.current: 職員意外立ち入るべからず。
ja.triageIssue: 「意外」は誤字で「以外」。掲示文として意味が逆/不明確になり得る。

ja.en: He's peeling his apple.
ja.current: 彼はリンゴを剥いでいます。
ja.triageIssue: リンゴの皮をむく場合は通常『剥いています』。『剥いでいます』は不自然で対象にも合いにくい。

ja.en: If something can go wrong it will go wrong.
ja.current: 形あるものはいつか壊れる。
ja.triageIssue: マーフィーの法則の意味が「失敗し得るものは失敗する」から「形あるものは壊れる」にずれている。

ja.en: You should have friends, buddy!
ja.current: 持つべきものは友よ友！
ja.triageIssue: Uses an idiom meaning 'friends are what one should have/valuable,' but misses the exhortation 'You should have friends' and sounds unnatural/repetitive.

ja.en: Beth's father discussed with her how strongly he expects her to be quiet.
ja.current: ベスの父はどんなに静かにしてもらいたいと思っているかを彼女に話しました。
ja.triageIssue: Awkward and incomplete; omits/blurred 'discussed with her' and 'how strongly he expects her to be quiet' is not naturally conveyed.

ja.en: I dislike going through customs at the airport because it takes so long.
ja.current: とても時間がかかるから空港での手続きに従うのは好きじゃない。
ja.triageIssue: “going through customs” means passing customs/immigration procedures, not “following procedures”; 空港での手続きに従う is unnatural and inaccurate.

ja.en: I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
ja.current: 私がどういった行動の方針をとるべきなのか、君に任せます。
ja.triageIssue: Subject is wrong: English means “I leave it to you what course of action to take,” but Japanese says “what course of action I should take,” implying the speaker’s action rather than the addressee/decision generally.

ja.en: Your words make me fear for my life.
ja.current: 君のことばをきいていると死ぬのが恐ろしくなる。
ja.triageIssue: Changes meaning to fear of dying; misses fear for my life caused by your words/threats.

ja.en: The touching episode came home to me.
ja.current: その痛ましいエピソードは私には痛切に感じられた。
ja.triageIssue: touching を「痛ましい」と誤訳しており感動的という意味から外れている。

ja.en: He is the person to whom I gave my dictionary.
ja.current: これは私が辞書をあげた人である。
ja.triageIssue: He isが「これは」になっており指示対象がずれている。自然には「彼が私が辞書をあげた人です」。

ja.en: This movie is very interesting to me.
ja.current: この映画はとても興味があります。
ja.triageIssue: 日本語の文法が不自然で、「映画は興味があります」は誤用。意味は推測可能だが自然な訳は「この映画は私にはとても面白い」。

ja.en: Maybe you'd better come with us.
ja.current: ことによると、きみにも一緒にきてもらう。
ja.triageIssue: Maybe you'd better の助言・提案が「もらう」という依頼/要求になっており不自然で意味がずれる。

ja.en: No, not too much.
ja.current: いいえ、あまり降りません。
ja.triageIssue: English alone means “No, not too much,” but Japanese specifies rainfall (“降りません”), adding context not present and potentially wrong unless prior context is rain.

ja.en: Experience without learning is better than learning without experience.
ja.current: 亀の甲より年の功。
ja.triageIssue: Japanese means age/experience beats mere cleverness/youth; not the same contrast between experience without learning and learning without experience.

ja.en: Fortune is the rod of the weak, and the staff of the brave.
ja.current: 鬼に金棒。
ja.triageIssue: 鬼に金棒 means making the strong even stronger; not the same as fortune supporting the weak/brave.

ja.en: When you take shelter, make sure you go under a big tree.
ja.current: 寄らば大樹の陰。
ja.triageIssue: 寄らば大樹の陰 means depend on the powerful for protection; as a literal shelter instruction it is misleading and omits 'make sure/go under a big tree' literal context.

ja.en: Give me a ring tomorrow.
ja.current: 明日電話を待ってるよ。
ja.triageIssue: Means 'I'll be waiting for your call'; English is request to call me.

ja.en: It's useless to try and resist.
ja.current: 無駄な抵抗をやめなさい。
ja.triageIssue: Changes meaning from stating resistance is useless to an imperative 'stop futile resistance'; modality omitted/altered.

ja.en: Don't forget to mail the letter.
ja.current: 忘れずにその手紙を投稿しなさい。
ja.triageIssue: 投稿 means posting/submitting content, not mailing a letter; should be 投函する/郵送する.

ja.en: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.
ja.current: 父の病状は一喜一憂です。
ja.triageIssue: 父の病状は一喜一憂です is unnatural and changes the subject; should describe family being alternately hopeful and worried as condition fluctuates.

ja.en: I was too exhausted to think, let alone study.
ja.current: 疲れきっていたので勉強するのはもちろん考えるのも嫌だった。
ja.triageIssue: Reverses emphasis: English says too exhausted even to think, much less study; Japanese says studying of course, even thinking was unpleasant.

ja.en: She can hardly walk, let alone run.
ja.current: 彼女は走るどころか、全く歩けもしない。
ja.triageIssue: can hardly walk は「ほとんど歩けない」であり、「全く歩けもしない」は強すぎる。let alone run の焦点もやや崩れる。

ja.en: She pushed her needle in and out.
ja.current: 彼女は針をすすめていた。
ja.triageIssue: Mistranslates the action; 'pushed her needle in and out' means moving the needle in and out while sewing, not simply 'advanced the needle'.

ja.en: She said good-by to me for good.
ja.current: 彼女は私にそれを最後にさよならを言った。
ja.triageIssue: 「それを最後に」が不自然で、for good の永久の別れという意味がやや曖昧。

ja.en: She watched the children swimming in the pool.
ja.current: 彼女は子供たちが池で泳ぐのをみました。
ja.triageIssue: “pool”を「池」と誤訳。通常は「プール」。

ja.en: She is a chatterbox.
ja.current: 彼女は口が軽い。
ja.triageIssue: 口が軽い means indiscreet/loose-lipped, not chatterbox/talkative.

ja.en: She is far from a fool.
ja.current: 彼女は愚か者どころではない。
ja.triageIssue: far from a fool は「愚か者などではない/むしろ賢い」。訳は「愚か者どころではない」で逆に非常に愚かとも読める。

ja.en: What does she do?
ja.current: 彼女は何をしているんですか。
ja.triageIssue: 英語は通常「彼女の職業は何ですか」の意味だが、訳は「彼女は今何をしているのか」に読める。

ja.en: Her ambition was consummated when she was elected to Congress.
ja.current: 彼女の野心国会に選出された時に達成された。
ja.triageIssue: 助詞が欠けており不自然（「野心が」）。

ja.en: Her classmates folded three hundred and fifty-six cranes so that one thousand were buried with her.
ja.current: 彼女の級友達は３５６羽の鶴を折り、千羽が彼女と一緒に埋葬された。
ja.triageIssue: Does not clearly express purpose “so that one thousand were buried with her”; Japanese implies consequence and is awkward/ambiguous.

ja.en: His explanation was by no means satisfactory.
ja.current: 彼の説得は満足できるものではなかった。
ja.triageIssue: explanation を「説得」と誤訳している。

ja.en: He successfully passed the exam.
ja.current: 彼は試験に見事に成功した。
ja.triageIssue: 成功した with 試験 is unnatural and can mean succeeded in the exam rather than passed; should be 試験に見事に合格した.

zh.en: Never do today what you can put off till tomorrow.
zh.current: 别把今天能做的事拖到明天。
zh.triageIssue: 意思反了；英文是反讽式地说能拖到明天的今天别做，中文却译成常规劝诫“别拖到明天”。

zh.en: She was thrilled with his presence.
zh.triageIssue: Pronoun error: English says she was thrilled by his presence, but Chinese says his presence made him excited.

zh.en: He came in with his eyes shining.
Such telling effects of contrast as Japanese artists produce by use of empty space.
zh.current: 日本艺术家利用留白制造出的那种对比效果真的很绝。
zh.triageIssue: 英文是名词短语/不完整句，强调“such telling effects of contrast”；译文加入“真的很绝”，语气和结构不忠实，且“telling”应为“显著/有力”。
英文是“Pip replied”，应为“皮普回答说/答道”；当前让“那是碗橱吗？”成为皮普的回答，叙述关系可疑且不自然。

zh.en: After the wind has stopped, let's sail the boat off to the open sea.
zh.current: 等风停了，咱们就把船开到外海去吧。
zh.triageIssue: Likely reversed/odd condition: sailing off after the wind stops is unnatural for 'sail'; English may mean after wind dies down, but translation '等风停了' implies no wind. Also '开船' weakens sail. Significant issue.

zh.en: I'm willing to take care of your children, if you want me to.
zh.current: 你要是愿意，我可以帮你带孩子。
zh.triageIssue: “if you want me to”是“如果你想让我照看”，译成“你要是愿意”改变了施事/意愿对象，容易误解。

zh.en: Beth's father discussed with her how strongly he expects her to be quiet.
zh.current: 贝丝她爸跟她谈了谈，希望她能安分点。
zh.triageIssue: 原文强调讨论“他多么强烈地期望她安静”，译文概括成“希望她安分点”，遗漏强烈程度和quiet，且“安分”含义偏差。

zh.en: John played cat and mouse with Dick.
zh.current: 约翰跟迪克玩起了猫捉老鼠的游戏。
zh.triageIssue: misses idiom 'play cat and mouse with' meaning to toy with/tease/manipulate, not literally play a game

ko.triageIssue: Assumes a hospital admissions desk; 'admissions office' commonly means an academic admissions office, so this may be wrong without context.

ko.en: I like Japanese rice pillows; they are good for my neck.
ko.triageIssue: Mistranslates/omits 'rice pillows'; says only 'Japanese-style pillows,' losing the key object.

ko.en: As soon as they realized the mayor was on his way down, his critics started coming out of the woodwork.
ko.current: 시장의 위세가 꺾였다는 걸 알자마자, 비판하던 사람들이 여기저기서 나타나기 시작했어요.
ko.triageIssue: 'On his way down' likely means the mayor was coming downstairs/coming down, not that his power was declining; translation changes the situation, though it captures 'critics coming out of the woodwork'.

ko.en: In case he gives me a phone call, tell him that I will call him back.
ko.current: 혹시 그 사람한테 전화 오면, 내가 다시 전화한다고 전해줘.
ko.triageIssue: Reverses direction of the call: English means if he calls me, tell him I will call him back; Korean says if a call comes from/for him ambiguously, and uses 그 사람한테 전화 오면 more like 'if he gets a call' or awkwardly not 'if he calls me.'

ko.en: At last, James Bond made it as an actor.
ko.triageIssue: Misreads 'James Bond' as the person who became successful as an actor; in English this likely means the actor playing James Bond finally made it, or a person named James Bond, but the wording is contextually odd and Korean sounds like the fictional character succeeded as an actor.

Korean sounds like asking someone not to allow the speaker to interfere, whereas English politely means 'please don't let me get in the way' / 'I hope I'm not interfering'; awkward and pragmatically off.
'Two pool lengths' means two lengths of the pool, not necessarily '두 바퀴' (two laps), which can imply a different distance.

ko.en: Well, my family's away and I can't afford to do much.
ko.current: 글쎄, 가족들은 다 어디 가고 나 혼자라 할 수 있는 게 별로 없어.
ko.triageIssue: Misses the financial meaning of 'can't afford to do much' and changes it to being alone with little to do.

ko.en: No matter how you look at it you're a beautiful, ill-fated woman, the heroine of a tragedy.
ko.current: 아무리 봐도 넌 비극의 여주인공 같은 미인 박명형이야.
ko.triageIssue: 'ill-fated woman' is rendered as the unnatural/incorrect phrase '박명형'; Korean is awkward and malformed. Should be something like '박복한 미인' or '불운한 여자'.

ko.en: She was wearing an ugly dress.
ko.triageIssue: 못생긴 is normally for people/faces; an ugly dress should be 못생긴 드레스가 아니라 못생긴/흉한/촌스러운 옷, e.g. 못생긴 is unnatural and awkward here.

ko.en: They have, among them, ruined our plan.
ko.current: 걔네가 어쩌다 보니 우리 계획을 망쳐버렸어.
ko.triageIssue: 'Among them' means collectively/between them, not '어쩌다 보니' (somehow/by chance). Significant meaning shift.

ko.en: He was provoked into hitting her.
ko.current: 그는 화를 참지 못하고 그녀를 때리고 말았어.
ko.triageIssue: Omits the key causative idea that he was provoked into hitting her.

ko.en: He struck at me with a stick.
ko.triageIssue: 'Struck at me' means attacked/swung at me, not necessarily successfully hit me; Korean says he hit me.

tr.en: There's a secret path on the left.
tr.triageIssue: Completely unrelated: says 'He/she is sleeping like a baby' instead of 'There's a secret path on the left.'

tr.en: Don't see life in terms of money.
tr.current: Bazı insanlar hayatı bir hikayeye benzetir.
tr.triageIssue: Tamamen alakasız çeviri; 'Hayatı para üzerinden görme' anlamı yok.

tr.en: Good day! You are our new neighbor, if I am not mistaken?
tr.triageIssue: Tamamen yanlış/alakasız çeviri; selam ve yeni komşu anlamı yok.

tr.en: Do you have any other hotels you would recommend?
tr.triageIssue: Completely unrelated translation; means 'Are you hungry?'

tr.en: Could you stand behind my car for a minute and tell me if my brake lights are working?
tr.triageIssue: Completely unrelated: asks whether you agree with Tom.

tr.en: There are a lot of gloomy sentences today.
tr.triageIssue: Completely unrelated: says 'Everyone died.'

tr.en: You haven't ever had to suffer a broken heart, or anything else, for that matter.
tr.triageIssue: Completely unrelated translation; means 'Tom is useless!'

tr.en: You should carry out his offer.
tr.triageIssue: 'Carry out his offer' ifadesi muhtemelen 'onun teklifini kabul etmeli/uygulamalısın' bağlamında; 'teklifini yerine getirmek' Türkçede doğal ve doğru değil, anlam sorunlu.

tr.en: Brought up by a weak father, he is partial to sweets.
tr.current: Zayıf bir babayla büyüdüğü için tatlıya düşkün.
tr.triageIssue: Anlam hatalı: 'weak father' fiziksel/karaktersel zayıf baba demek; 'zayıf bir babayla büyüdüğü için' ifadesi 'babasıyla birlikte büyüdü' gibi ve neden-sonuç anlamını bozuyor. 'Zayıf iradeli bir baba tarafından yetiştirildiği için' gibi olmalı.

tr.en: His grandfather passed away peacefully.
tr.triageIssue: Yazım/biçim hatası var: 'Dedesı' yanlış, 'Dedesi' olmalı.

tr.en: She waved both her hands so that he could find her.
tr.current: Onu bulabilsin diye iki elini de salladı.
tr.triageIssue: Pronoun roles are reversed/ambiguous: English says she waved so he could find her; Turkish reads as 'so she could find him'.

tr.en: I talked a long time, and I managed to make her believe me.
tr.current: Uzun uzun konuştum ve ona kendime inandırmayı başardım.
tr.triageIssue: Grammar error changes meaning: 'ona kendime inandırmayı' means making her believe in myself; should be 'onu bana inandırmayı/ona kendimi inandırmayı' depending intended. Current is malformed.

tr.en: We take part in Red Cross movement.
tr.triageIssue: ‘Red Cross’ is 'Kızılhaç'; 'Kızılay' refers to the Red Crescent/Turkish Red Crescent, changing the organization/movement.

tr.en: As soon as they realized the mayor was on his way down, his critics started coming out of the woodwork.
tr.current: Belediye başkanının gözden düştüğünü anladıkları anda, eleştirenleri dört bir yandan ortaya çıkmaya başladı.
tr.triageIssue: Misreads 'on his way down' as 'gözden düştüğünü' rather than literally/on his way down; 'critics' as 'eleştirenleri' is awkward. Idiom 'out of the woodwork' is reasonably conveyed but premise is wrong.

tr.en: The bank rate cut is expected to relieve the severe financial squeeze that has hit industry.
tr.current: Banka faiz indirimi, sanayiyi vuran ciddi finansal sıkışıklığı hafifletmesi bekleniyor.
tr.triageIssue: Dilbilgisi bozuk: 'Banka faiz indirimi ... hafifletmesi bekleniyor' yapısı eksik/yanlış; özne-yüklem uyumu sorunlu.

tr.en: We noticed the man enter her room.
tr.triageIssue: 'Her room' is translated as 'odasına' (his/her room) but the subject is ambiguous; more critically the sentence implies a different person's room (her=the woman's), losing this distinction

tr.en: You acted after your nature. Think of all the trouble you would give him.
tr.current: Doğana göre davrandın. Ona ne kadar sıkıntı çıkaracağını bir düşünsene.
tr.triageIssue: 'Doğana göre davrandın' is unnatural/incorrect for 'acted after your nature'; second sentence tense/modality is also off ('would give him').

tr.en: He couldn't bring himself to believe her story.
tr.triageIssue: Wrong modality: 'couldn't bring himself to believe' means he could not make himself believe it, but Turkish says he could not force himself to believe, which is close superficially yet unnatural and can imply effort rather than inability to accept; better 'hikayesine bir türlü inanamadı'.

tr.en: Happy anniversary!
tr.triageIssue: 'Mutlu yıllar' means 'Happy New Year/Birthday'; 'anniversary' should be 'yıl dönümün kutlu olsun'

tr.en: I eat pineapple sherbert.
tr.triageIssue: 'Sherbert/sherbet' in English likely means sorbet/ice dessert, but Turkish 'şerbet' is a drink/syrup and 'yerim' is unnatural for it; meaning likely wrong.

tr.en: "Is this correct?", "Yes, that is the correct answer!"
tr.triageIssue: Incomplete; omits the response 'Yes, that is the correct answer!'.

tr.en: You don't need to go unless you want to.
tr.triageIssue: Mantık tersine dönmüş. İngilizce 'istemediğin sürece gitmene gerek yok' / 'ancak istersen git' anlamında; Türkçe 'istemiyorsan gitmek zorunda değilsin' yakın görünse de 'want to' koşulunun kapsamını tam vermiyor ve bağlama göre 'unless you want to' iznini eksiltiyor.

tr.en: "Where's that superstition from?" "Call it folk wisdom."
tr.current: "Bu batıl inanç nereden çıktı?" "Halk bilgeliği de geç."
tr.triageIssue: 'Call it folk wisdom' ifadesi doğal/gramer olarak yanlış çevrilmiş; 'halk bilgeliği diyelim' gibi olmalı.

tr.en: I have to go through the task by tomorrow.
tr.triageIssue: ‘Go through the task’ means to complete/work through the task; 'göreve bakmak' is vague and unnatural, not an accurate rendering.

tr.en: The fowler's pipe sounds sweet till the bird is caught.
tr.current: Kuş avlanana kadar sesi güzel gelir.
tr.triageIssue: Atasözü eksik/yanlış aktarılmış; 'fowler's pipe' yani avcının düdüğü/ötüşü ve aldatıcı tatlılık kaybolmuş.

tr.en: Little did she dream that her son would commit suicide.
tr.current: Oğlu'nun intihar edeceğini rüyasında görse inanmazdı.
tr.triageIssue: Anlam bozulmuş; 'aklının ucundan bile geçmedi' gerekir, rüya/inanmazdı ifadesi yanlış ve yazım hatalı.

tr.en: She can hardly walk, let alone run.
tr.triageIssue: 'Can hardly walk' zar zor yürüyebilir demektir; 'yürüyemiyor bile' daha güçlü ve anlamı değiştiriyor.

tr.en: She has been married to him for a decade now.
tr.triageIssue: 'Ona evli' is grammatically incorrect in Turkish; should be 'Onunla on yıldır evli'

tr.en: He has a habit of looking down on coloured people.
tr.triageIssue: ‘Coloured people’ means people of color/non-white people; 'renkli insanlar' is a literal and unnatural/misleading translation in Turkish.
